message.content: {"needs_revision": false, "reasoning": "The code performs leakage-safe preprocessing: feature engineering and target encoding are fit only on training folds, while validation folds are transformed using fitted state. The final refit uses only training rows and labels, and prediction loads the persisted pipeline without refitting.
